title: Statistical Properties of the Sharpe Ratio Estimator
description: This work investigates the finite-sample and asymptotic properties of the Sharpe ratio estimator under progressively realistic return processes, ranging from IID Normal to AR(1)-GARCH(1,1). Combining the method of moments with the delta method, we derive closed-form expressions for the asymptotic variance under each specification. We assess the empirical coverage of asymptotic confidence intervals via Monte Carlo simulation, develop analytical corrections for finite-sample bias, and apply the framework to real financial returns. Complementary analyses cover parameter sensitivity, alternative metrics, and the joint asymptotic distribution of the Sharpe ratio with Value-at-Risk.
